data.narrative:
Herasight is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Michael Christensen that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private comparables including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach, using the $5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $12.5M. The peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage filtering within the biotech peer set (zero same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables met the ≥3 datapoint threshold). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied without disclosed revenue, which is standard for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer valuation data at identical stage and capitalization, and the lack of revenue visibility to anchor alternative methods. Additional capital raises, detailed financial metrics, and market comparables will be critical to refine this estimate at future rounds.
